name: statefall
description: Headless simulation tests and release tooling for Statefall

scripts.test: npm run test:harness-hardening && npm run test:browser-server && npm run test:security && npm run test:seeded-order && npm run test:replaycheck && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:restart && npm run determinism
scripts.test:restart: node tests/restart-replay.js standard && node tests/restart-replay.js fog && node tests/restart-replay.js garrisons
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run verify:browser
scripts.release:assets: node tools/build-howto.js game/index.html pkg/howto && node tools/build-flags.js game/index.html pkg/flags.js
